title: Corporate expense web system
description: User, group and permission management modules for a responsive solution, with SAP integration to automate accounting processes.

problem.title: The Problem
problem.intro: Coca-Cola Embonor needed a solution to manage corporate expenses: users, groups and permissions, and above all to automate sending accounting data to SAP, which was done by hand and with errors.
items: Manual management of users, groups and permissions
Manual sending of accounting data to SAP with recurring errors
Need for a responsive solution across multiple devices
Accounting processes that consumed time and generated errors

phases.title: 1. User, group and permission modules
phases.description: Built user, group and permission management for a responsive solution processing hundreds of daily transactions.
items: Hundreds of transactions processed per day

phases.title: 2. SAP API integration
phases.description: Integrated the solution with the SAP API to automate accounting processes via structured data.

phases.title: 3. Manual error reduction
phases.description: Automating the SAP delivery eliminated manual entry and measurably reduced errors.

subsections.title: Complete access management
subsections.description: Users, groups and permissions centralized in a responsive solution.

subsections.title: Accounting automation with SAP
subsections.description: Accounting data is sent to SAP automatically and in a structured way.
items: Direct integration with the SAP API

subsections.title: Measurable result
subsections.description: Fewer errors, less manual work, more reliability.
items: Stack: ASP.NET + C# + SQL Server + Entity Framework + SAP API

items.label: Automation pays:
items.text: integrating with SAP eliminated manual entry and reduced accounting errors by 75%.

items.label: Well-modeled access:
items.text: managing users, groups and permissions from the start avoided security rework.

items.label: Responsive matters:
items.text: the team uses the solution from multiple devices, so responsive design was a requirement, not decoration.

cta.title: Need to automate accounting processes or integrate SAP?
cta.subtitle: If your team enters data by hand and has errors, I can help automate it. I did it for Coca-Cola Embonor with -75% errors.
